author: Natuzzu
quote: GTA 6 feels like a betrayal of everything that made this franchise great. Instead of compelling characters, memorable personalities, and the freedom to create your own stories, we're getting boring protagonists who struggle to capture any real interest. A GTA game should make you feel immersed in a chaotic, unpredictable world, not force you to follow characters you couldn't care less about. Bigger graphics and a prettier map mean absolutely nothing if the soul of the franchise is gone. Rockstar seems more interested in spectacle than substance, and that's a damn shame.
